candidates.sentence: She will do whatever it takes to prevent a national abortion ban.​
Marie will do whatever it takes to prevent a national abortion ban, which would override the will of the people of Washington State.
Marie will always fight to make sure state and local law enforcement agencies have the resources they need to keep Fentanyl and illegal guns off of our streets.

She supports re-introducing and expanding the Child Tax Credit, which makes it easier for parents to make the choices that best work for their families, whether that’s paying a family member or going to a traditional daycare.
Marie believes in fighting the drug crisis through increased border security, stricter punishments for sale and possession, expanded access to treatment and rehab, and better job opportunities.
Marie supports common sense legislation to strengthen the Social Security program for the long-run without raising the retirement age or reducing benefits.
